biography:
Kimi Kim, a 16-year-old hailing from Montreal, Canada, burst onto the racing scene with an unmistakable flair. Growing up in a family of modest means, Kimi's passion for racing was ignited by late-night broadcasts of Formula 1 races emanating from Europe. His first taste of competitive driving came through online sim racing, where his raw talent and aggressive style quickly made him a force to be reckoned with. Scrapping together funds, Kimi convinced a local karting team to give him a shot. His breakthrough moment arrived during the Quebec Provincial Karting Championship, where he recovered from a last-place start to snatch victory in the final corner, a testament to his never-say-die attitude.

Now competing as an independent driver, Kimi faces the challenge of securing sponsorship to advance his career. He recently transitioned into Formula 4, showcasing glimpses of brilliance amidst the financial constraints. During a race at Circuit Mont-Tremblant, Kimi's worn tires caused him to miss a crucial braking point, resulting in a spectacular off-track excursion; nonetheless, his recovery to finish within the points was lauded by many. His commitment to independent racing is fueled by a desire to prove that talent, rather than money, is the most important ingredient for success.

Kimi's flashy personality and aggressive driving style have already garnered him a dedicated fanbase, drawn to his underdog status. He is determined to climb the racing ladder, one race at a time, proving that a kid from Montreal can make it to the very top. His goal is to one day compete in Formula 1 and he believes his unique perspective, being an independent driver, will give him the edge he needs to succeed.
drivingStyle: Kimi's driving style is characterized by aggressive overtaking maneuvers and late-braking techniques. He possesses an innate ability to find grip where others can't, often pushing the car to its absolute limit. While his tire management skills are still developing, Kimi thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest. He favors a high-risk, high-reward approach, believing that calculated aggression is the key to victory.

rivalries.name: Antoine Dubois
rivalries.reason: A long-standing karting rivalry fueled by contrasting driving styles; Antoine embodies precision and consistency, the antithesis of Kimi's flamboyant approach.

rivalries.name: Isabella Rossi
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities both on and off the track. Isabella and Kimi both want to be the top Canadian driver, leading to constant battles on the track.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Kenji is the son of a wealthy businessman. Kimi believes Kenji's wealth has given him an unfair advantage, leading to a heated rivalry.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of red socks for every race.
Listens to a specific playlist of 90s hip-hop before getting into the car.
Meticulously polishes his helmet visor before each session, believing it enhances his focus.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about going fast, it's about leaving your mark. They might remember the winner, but they'll never forget the guy who tried everything."
careerHighlight: Winning the Quebec Provincial Karting Championship after starting last due to a mechanical issue, showcasing his resilience and determination.
careerLowPoint: Spinning out of a Formula 4 race while leading in wet conditions, costing him a potential podium finish and valuable championship points.
